editorial.blurb: El Cid serves authentic Mexican fare with the warmth of a 30-year legacy—expect bold flavors, crispy textures, and genuine hospitality that keeps families coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive during off-peak hours to avoid service hiccups; order the skirt steak quesadillas and chili rellenos, and don't miss the complimentary fresh chips and salsa while you settle in.
